ambient_events: Two tubes are made up and set in the rack to stand.
A number goes on the board in the same hand as every number above it.
Water moves through the beds with a sound like a long sigh.
description: The town's pride, and the only building in it that has been painted. Settling tanks stepped down a frame, beds of crushed limestone and burnt bone, and a covered cistern with a lid that takes four people to lift and is lifted every week to be looked at.
name: The Sweetwater
